reason: 该插件的用户面向目标可从仓库名称、说明和 DSH 清单看出：它主要用于为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可安装的界面增强（主题与布局/面板改造及通知），属于 UI 体验改造为主；同时包含可选的 Windows 原生窗口与协议/启动器相关实现，属于非核心附加能力。

summaries.zh: 这是一个可安装到 DeepSeek Harness 的界面增强插件，提供 Shadow 主题、看板侧边抽屉与任务完成提醒，并可选提供 Windows 原生窗口入口。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a Shadow theme, a kanban-style side panel, and task-completion notifications, with an optional Windows native window entry option.

capabilities: Injects custom theme/visual assets into the DSH web client
Provides a right-side Kanban-style drawer UI
Includes optional Windows native launcher/window integration
Packages plugin entrypoints for DSH web platform loading

reasons.code: README states primary features are Shadow theme, Kanban drawer, and task completion notifications delivered via plugin injection
package.json includes DSH bundle patch and client configuration for web platform injection
repository tree includes optional native Windows source, scripts, and executable-related files for an auxiliary desktop entry path
